verdict.rationale: Tailscale's own docs describe setting up a webhook to receive notifications of events on your tailnet, and list webhooks among its automation integrations. That is a first-party, registrable outbound event callback. The evidence is only one-line doc summaries, so depth is thin. missing for 10: documented event types/payload schema, delivery details (signing, retries), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
